I the two RotoPD supply wires
B STEP, DIR, EN, MS1, MS2
The whole board, row by row
B EN, I VM in, J cap +
B MS1, I GND in, J cap -
A hole you cannot account for is a wire in
the wrong row. Pull it out and find it on
Then the meter, page 22. It finds what a count cannot: two
wires in one row that should not share it.
